name: Deezer
author: Deunnis
description: Deezer now-playing widget with playback controls

barWidget.description: Shows the current Deezer track. Click to play/pause, right-click to skip, scroll to go next/previous.

schema.label: Icon
schema.description: Icon shown on the bar, in the popup header, and as the album-art placeholder.

schema.label: Blur
schema.description: Backdrop blur strength behind the popup (applies to all bar popups, not just Deezer's).

schema.label: Transparency
schema.description: How see-through the popup background is.

schema.label: Outline thickness
schema.description: Border width of the popup card and album art frame, in pixels.

schema.label: Corner roundness
schema.description: Corner radius of the popup card, in pixels.
